title: Squarespace Templates
meta: Start from a polished Squarespace template and we tailor it to your brand with your logo, colors and content. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Squarespace templates made to look like you
overview: Start from a Squarespace template that already looks good and let us make it yours. We help you choose a layout, then apply your logo, fonts and colors, remove the demo content and fill the pages with your own words and images. Templates share the same editor, so you can keep changing things later. It is a quick, affordable route to a branded site that avoids the cost of a custom design.

pkgs.blurb: A template, branded and filled with your content.
A tailored template with extra sections and a form.
A template reshaped so it feels fully custom.
list: Up to 5 sections restyled or added
Gallery, blog or shop page set up

faq: Squarespace templates come with your Squarespace plan. The plan, domain and any extensions are paid to Squarespace by you. Our price is for choosing, setting up and styling the template.
Can you help me choose a template?
Yes. Share your business and a few sites you like, and we suggest two or three starting layouts with a short reason for each. You decide, then we begin.
On Squarespace 7.1 you can restyle freely inside your site, and layouts are built from sections you can reorder. That is why we focus on a sensible start, not on locking you in.
Do you add sections the template lacks?
Yes, within the package limits. We build the new section to match the template's style, and count it against your sections-customized limit.
